 Oral Judgment

(PER: THE HON'BLE MR JUSTICE HANCHATE SANJEEVKUMAR) This appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 20.05.2023 passed in MVC No.2007/2021 on the file of Senior Civil Judge and Additional MACT, Bailhongal (hereinafter referred to as 'the Tribunal' for short) seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. For the sake of convenience and easy reference, the parties are referred to as per their rankings before the Tribunal.
3. Heard the arguments from both learned counsels appearing for the parties and perused the material placed on records.

Brief facts of the case:
4. It is the case of the claimant that on 28.06.2021 at about 11:30 am, the claimant went to NC:
2025:KHC-D:7336 HC-KAR Nesargi and after completing his work, he was returning to Karimani on his TVS Excel 50 motorcycle bearing No.KA- 24/Y-0039, driving at a moderate speed, observing traffic rules and regulations on the extreme left side of the Belagavi-Bagalkot Road.

When he came near the spot of the accident, i.e., on Belagavi-Bagalkot Road near Swamy Vivekananda School,
Kalakuppi, at that time, the driver of the truck bearing No.KA-22/B-0416 came from the opposite direction to the extreme wrong side, driving in a high speed, rash, and negligent manner, without seeing the oncoming motorcycle of the claimant, and suddenly turned his vehicle and touched his right-side wheel tyre to the claimant's motorcycle.
Thus, the accident was caused, and the claimant sustained injuries in the said accident.

7. Considering the nature of injuries sustained, compensation awarded by Tribunal is lesser side.
Therefore, the same is required to be enhanced by modifying the judgment and award.

8. Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.80,000/- towards pain and suffering,
NC: 2025:KHC-D:7336 HC-KAR Rs.50,000/- towards loss of amenities and enjoyment in life are awarded.
The compensation awarded towards medical expenses Rs.2,95,803/- is as per the actual bills and receipts produced; therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.20,000/- towards incidental expenses like diet, food, nourishment, attendant, conveyance charges etc. and Rs.42,750,/- towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of 3 months, is awarded.

The claimant has suffered grievous injuries, including a displaced fracture of the right frontal bone and roof of the orbit, with a displaced fragment measuring 4.5 x 6.2 cm, and pneu tocephalus in the right frontal, anterior temporal, parietal region, and along with the falx cerebri.
Therefore, he required significant medical expenses to recover.
